subtitle: Backend Developer
description: Personal portfolio of Danilo Lopes, a backend developer focused on Node.js, C#/.NET Core and cloud technologies.
heroBio: Backend developer building reliable APIs and services, from database design to cloud deployment.
aboutText:
Hello

I’m a developer passionate about technology and fascinated by the world of software development. With over 4 years of experience, I have been creating personal projects and continuously improving my skills, with a special focus on back-end development.

Here, you can explore some of the projects I have developed and the ones I’m currently working on. Are you here out of curiosity or because I shared this with you? Either way, feel free to explore!

Additionally, right below, you’ll find the technologies I work with and improve my skills in daily.
projectsDescription: Here are some of the projects I’ve developed.
projectDesc1: Automated real-time package tracking WhatsApp bot built with Node.js and Baileys library, handling asynchronous event flows.
projectDesc2: REST API built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB featuring secure JWT authentication, route validation, and frontend integration.
projectDesc3: Web API developed in C# (ASP.NET Core) with full CRUD operations, MySQL database integration, and clean layered architecture.
skillsDescription: Technologies, tools, and concepts I apply in software development.
skillBackendDesc: Building high-performance RESTful APIs, microservices, and real-time automations with Clean Architecture and SOLID.
skillDatabaseDesc: Relational and NoSQL modeling focused on integrity, ACID transactions, migrations, and optimized queries.
skillDevopsDesc: Environment parity with Docker & Docker Compose, version control, and cloud deployments (AWS / Linux).
skillFrontendDesc: Developing fast, responsive, modern web interfaces with Next.js and Tailwind CSS integrated with APIs.
